=== BEGIN ARTIFACT TOPOLOGY.md ===
## Declarations

## story foundation
summary:      Stand up the Go module, directory layout, and architecture for csvstat.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   ARCHITECTURE.md
stack:        common.md, go.md
provides:     go.mod, internal/, cmd/csvstat/, bin/
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Create the root go.mod (module path csvstat, Go 1.22 or newer, no third-party requires) and the
  layout: cmd/csvstat (package main), internal/cli, internal/csvdata, internal/profile,
  internal/freq, bin/.

  Document in ARCHITECTURE.md the package ownership, the Run(args []string, stdout, stderr
  io.Writer) int entry contract, the exit-code table (0, 1, 2, 3), and the rule that only main calls
  os.Exit. State that sources/ is read-only and that application code never reads sources/run.sh
  or embeds an answer.

## story executable
summary:      Build the csvstat executable from the module root with a thin main over cli.Run.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Executable.md
covers:       FOUND-001
accepts:      st-003
stack:        go.md
provides:     csvstat command, cli.Run
depends:      foundation
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement cmd/csvstat/main.go, which calls cli.Run(os.Args[1:], os.Stdout, os.Stderr) and passes
  the result to os.Exit. Implement a minimal internal/cli.Run that returns 0 so the module builds
  with go build ./cmd/csvstat using only the standard library.

## story args-parsing
summary:      Parse options and exactly one file argument, with options preceding the file.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Arguments.md
covers:       CLI-001
stack:        go.md
provides:     cli.ParseArgs
consumes:     cli.Run
depends:      executable
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  In internal/cli, parse args with a local flag.FlagSet using flag.ContinueOnError and output
  discarded. Recognise --column <name>, --freq <name>, --top <n>, then exactly one positional file.
  Return a typed Options value (Column, Freq, Top, TopSet, File) or a usage error. Validation of
  combinations belongs to the usage-errors story.

## story csv-reading
summary:      Read UTF-8 RFC 4180 CSV with the first record as header.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CsvReading.md
covers:       INGEST-001
stack:        go.md
provides:     csvdata.Read
depends:      foundation
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  In internal/csvdata, read a file with encoding/csv (FieldsPerRecord = -1 so raggedness is judged
  by this package, LazyQuotes off). Return header and data records. A quoted field containing a
  comma is one value. A line ending after the last record creates no extra record. Record the source
  line number of each record for diagnostics.

## story value-trimming
summary:      Trim leading and trailing spaces from every header name and value.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Trimming.md
covers:       INGEST-002
stack:        go.md
provides:     csvdata trimming
depends:      csv-reading
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  After reading, trim spaces from every header name and every value before any other rule applies.
  Trim spaces only (not other whitespace classes beyond what the source states).

## story null-values
summary:      Recognise null spellings: empty, NA, N/A, NULL ignoring case.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-NullValues.md
covers:       INGEST-003
stack:        go.md
provides:     csvdata.IsNull
depends:      value-trimming
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement IsNull on a trimmed value. A quoted empty field is empty and null. A value of only
  spaces becomes empty after trimming and is null.

## story input-rejection
summary:      Reject empty files, empty or repeated header names, and ragged records.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-InputRejection.md
covers:       INGEST-004
accepts:      st-007
stack:        go.md
provides:     csvdata.ErrRejected
depends:      value-trimming
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Return a rejection error (carrying the line number for a ragged record) for: an empty file, a
  file with only blank lines, an empty header name, a repeated header name, or any record whose
  field count differs from the header. A header-only file is valid and has zero rows. The cli layer
  maps this error to exit 3.

## story numeric-types
summary:      Infer integer and number column types.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-NumericTypes.md
covers:       TYPE-001
accepts:      st-004
stack:        go.md
provides:     profile.InferType (integer, number)
depends:      null-values
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  In internal/profile, a column is integer when every non-null value matches -?[0-9]+, and number
  when every non-null value matches -?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?. Integer is tested first. Use anchored
  regular expressions or hand-written scanners; no float parsing for classification.

## story date-type
summary:      Infer date columns of real YYYY-MM-DD calendar dates.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-DateType.md
covers:       TYPE-002
accepts:      st-004
stack:        go.md
provides:     profile.InferType (date)
depends:      numeric-types
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  A column is date when every non-null value matches YYYY-MM-DD and is a real calendar date
  (2025-02-30 is not). Validate with time.Parse using layout 2006-01-02 plus a digit-shape check.

## story boolean-text-types
summary:      Infer boolean, text, and empty column types.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-BooleanTextTypes.md
covers:       TYPE-003
accepts:      st-004
stack:        go.md
provides:     profile.InferType (boolean, text, empty)
depends:      date-type
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Boolean when every non-null value equals true or false ignoring case. Text is the fallback. A
  column with no non-null value is empty. The full order is integer, number, date, boolean, text.

## story row-counts
summary:      Report rows, nulls, and distinct counts per column.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-RowCounts.md
covers:       STAT-001
accepts:      st-005
stack:        go.md
provides:     profile.Counts
depends:      null-values, input-rejection
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  rows is the data record count, nulls the null value count, distinct the number of different
  trimmed non-null strings compared exactly. A header-only file yields rows 0 for every column.

## story min-max
summary:      Compute min and max by column type.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-MinMax.md
covers:       STAT-002
accepts:      st-005
stack:        go.md
provides:     profile.MinMax
depends:      boolean-text-types
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  integer and number: compare exactly (math/big), not as float64. date: earliest and latest.
  boolean: min is false if any value is false else true; max is true if any value is true else
  false; written lowercase regardless of input case. text: smallest and largest by byte value.
  empty: blank. A single non-null value is both min and max.

## story sum-mean
summary:      Compute exact sum and mean for integer and number columns.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-SumMean.md
covers:       STAT-003
accepts:      st-005
stack:        go.md
provides:     profile.SumMean
depends:      boolean-text-types
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Use math/big (big.Rat) for exact arithmetic. Sum is the exact total of non-null values; mean is
  the total divided by the non-null count. Other types have no sum or mean. Keep exact values for
  the formatting story to round once at output time.

## story median
summary:      Compute the median for integer and number columns.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-Median.md
covers:       STAT-004
accepts:      st-005
stack:        go.md
provides:     profile.Median
depends:      sum-mean
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Sort the non-null values exactly (big.Rat). With an odd count take the middle value; with an even
  count take the mean of the two middle values, exactly.

## story decimal-format
summary:      Format decimal results to two places, rounded half away from zero once.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-DecimalFormat.md
covers:       STAT-005
accepts:      st-005
stack:        go.md
provides:     profile.FormatDecimal
depends:      min-max, sum-mean, median
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Format a big.Rat with exactly two decimals, rounding half away from zero from the exact value,
  with a leading minus only when the rounded result is non-zero (no negative zero), and no
  thousands separator. Number min, max, sum, mean, and median and integer mean and median use it.
  Integer min, max, and sum are plain integers.

## story profile-output
summary:      Write the column profile as RFC 4180 CSV for the default invocation.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-ProfileOutput.md
covers:       OUT-001
accepts:      st-005
stack:        go.md
provides:     csvstat <file>
consumes:     csvdata.Read, profile.InferType, profile.Counts, profile.FormatDecimal, cli.ParseArgs
depends:      decimal-format, row-counts, args-parsing
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  When neither --column nor --freq is given, write header column,type,rows,nulls,distinct,min,max,
  sum,mean,median and one row per column in file order using encoding/csv with \n line endings so
  fields containing commas, quotes, or newlines are quoted. Build the full output in memory and
  write to stdout only on success.

## story freq-count
summary:      Count and order distinct non-null values of a column.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-FreqCount.md
covers:       FREQ-001
accepts:      st-006
stack:        go.md
provides:     freq.Count
depends:      null-values, input-rejection
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  In internal/freq, count trimmed non-null values, order by count descending then value ascending
  by byte value, and write header value,count then rows. Nulls are omitted. A column with no
  non-null value writes only the header.

## story freq-limit
summary:      Limit frequency rows with --top, default 5.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-FreqLimit.md
covers:       FREQ-002
accepts:      st-006
stack:        go.md
provides:     freq.Top
depends:      freq-count
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Apply a row limit after ordering. Default is 5 when --top is not given. A limit larger than the
  distinct count lists all values.

## story usage-errors
summary:      Reject malformed arguments with exit 2 and a usage line on standard error.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-UsageErrors.md
covers:       CLI-004
accepts:      st-008
stack:        go.md
provides:     exit code 2
depends:      args-parsing
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Exit 2, with nothing on stdout, for: missing file, extra file, unknown option, missing option
  value, --top not a positive integer, --top without --freq, and --column with --freq. Write one
  stderr line showing both command forms.

## story column-profile
summary:      Profile a single named column with --column.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-ColumnProfile.md
covers:       CLI-002
accepts:      st-007
stack:        go.md
provides:     csvstat --column
depends:      profile-output, usage-errors
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Write the profile header and only the named column's row. A column name absent from the trimmed
  header exits 3 with nothing on stdout. Match names exactly and case-sensitively.

## story freq-mode
summary:      Select frequency mode with --freq.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-FreqMode.md
covers:       CLI-003
accepts:      st-006, st-007
stack:        go.md
provides:     csvstat --freq, csvstat --freq --top
depends:      freq-limit, usage-errors
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Dispatch to the frequency listing when --freq is given, honouring --top. A column name absent
  from the header exits 3 with nothing on stdout.

## story failure-diagnostics
summary:      Write one stderr diagnostic line and nothing on stdout when a command fails.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-FailureDiagnostics.md
covers:       ERR-001
stack:        go.md
provides:     stderr diagnostics
depends:      input-rejection, usage-errors, profile-output
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Failures write one stderr line naming the file and, for a ragged record, its line number. Stdout
  stays empty on every failure. Exit 3 for rejected input.

## story unreadable-file
summary:      Exit 1 when the file cannot be opened or read.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-UnreadableFile.md
covers:       ERR-002
accepts:      st-008
stack:        go.md
provides:     exit code 1
depends:      failure-diagnostics
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  A missing or unreadable file exits 1 with nothing on stdout and one stderr line naming the file.

## story test-gate
summary:      Provide bin/test.sh running go vet and go test and the project test suite.
type:         service
kind:         test harness
phase:        4
implements:   FEATURE-TestGate.md
covers:       FOUND-002
accepts:      st-002
stack:        common.md, go.md
provides:     bin/test.sh
depends:      column-profile, freq-mode, unreadable-file
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Write a POSIX sh bin/test.sh that cds to the application root, runs go vet ./... then
  go test ./..., and exits non-zero if either fails. Ensure the suite covers each type, each
  statistic, null handling, rounding, each output form, and each exit code using files the tests
  write to temporary directories.

## story release-verification
summary:      Pass the supplied grader sources/run.sh with all 22 checks.
type:         feature
kind:         test harness
phase:        4
implements:   VERIFICATION.md
covers:       VERIFY-001
accepts:      st-001
stack:        common.md
depends:      test-gate, column-profile, freq-mode, unreadable-file
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Assembly story. When every member story is closed, run the supplied grader unfiltered
  (Suite: full) and require exit 0. Repair any failure in the owning package, never in sources/.
=== END ARTIFACT ===
